issue.title: GetFieldMapping API is not available in ES 1.0.0

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
We just installed ES 1.0.0 but the GetFieldMapping API always returned empty response.

http://localhost:9200/index/doc/_mapping/field/*
always responded {} 

This problem is causing Kibana 3 milestone 5 to display the following error:

No index found at https://server/logstash-2014.02.20/_mapping/field/*
Please create at least one index.If you're using a proxy ensure it is configured correctly.
